_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): code block — dark panel, language label, copy button, lightweight syntax highlighting (python/js/ts/bash, zero deps). Pairs comp-chat + comp-markdown-viewer. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-code-block
description: Code block: dark panel, language label, copy button, lightweight syntax highlighting (py/js/ts/bash). Zero deps.
notes: Usage: <CodeBlock code={snippet} language='python' /> — render AI chat code answers (wrap in comp-chat bubbles or comp-markdown-viewer fenced blocks). Highlighting covers keywords/strings/comments for python/javascript/typescript/bash; other languages render plain. Copy uses the clipboard API.
